findings.title: Exact multiples of the page size produce an empty extra page
findings.body: totalPages uses floor(user_count / limit) + 1, so a group with 50 members and a limit of 50 reports two pages. The Next action remains enabled on the actual last page and requests offset 50, displaying an empty member list. Use ceiling division for nonempty groups so the page count and showingLast match the available results.

findings.title: Public member lists are truncated without a way to load subsequent pages
findings.body: The shared findMembers method now requests only 50 members, and the server applies that limit to all groups. This public route fetches only once, while the public group/members template has no pagination or load-more controls. Consequently, members beyond the first 50 are inaccessible on the public group page; previously nonautomatic groups returned their complete membership. Add pagination to the public page alongside the new paginated response.

findings.title: Existing membership PATCH requests silently hide groups
findings.body: The resources route still accepts PATCH /admin/groups/:id, but update no longer handles the previously supported changes: {add: ... , delete: ...} payload. Such a request now ignores the membership changes and sets visible to false because it contains no visible parameter, then returns success. Existing API clients therefore silently lose their membership updates and unintentionally hide the group. Preserve the PATCH contract or explicitly reject unsupported payloads without modifying the group.
